Heatmap: Visualize expression profiles across samples and genes using interactive heatmaps. Select genes and cohorts to explore protein expression patterns.
Boxplot: Compare expression levels between different groups or conditions using boxplots. Choose genes and cohorts to analyze distributions.
Density Plots: Display the distribution of expression values for selected genes across cohorts. Useful for understanding data spread and outliers.
Volcano Plots: Show differential expression results with statistical significance. Visualize upregulated and downregulated genes in volcano plots.
Heatmap Cancer Subtypes: Explore expression profiles across cancer subtypes using heatmaps. Select subtypes and genes for detailed analysis.
Heatmap Immune Subtypes: Analyze expression data across immune subtypes with heatmaps. Choose immune subtypes and genes to investigate.
Pancan Gene vs Gene: Create scatter plots to examine correlations between two genes across all samples. Select genes to see their relationship.
Pancan Gene vs all: Correlate a selected gene with all other genes in the dataset. Identify strong positive or negative correlations.
Pancan Gene Panel: Display a panel of correlations for multiple genes. Select a panel of genes to compare their expression relationships.
LSCC Ubiquityl: Specific analysis for LSCC ubiquitylation data. Explore ubiquitylation patterns in LSCC samples.
LSCC Upset: Use upset plots to visualize intersections of gene sets in LSCC data. Understand overlapping gene expressions.
Oncoplot: Visualize somatic mutations across samples and genes using oncoplots. Select genes and cohorts to see mutation landscapes.
Lollipop: Display mutations along the protein sequence with lollipop plots. Choose genes to view mutation positions and types.
QTL Analysis: Perform quantitative trait locus analysis on genetic data. Link genetic variants to phenotypic traits.
CCLE Drug Sensitivity: Explore drug sensitivity data from CCLE. Analyze how different cell lines respond to drugs.
Download Data: Download various datasets used in the app. Select and export data for further analysis.
